props.gloss_en: the baraita: whoever did not see the rejoicing of the Beit HaShoeva never saw rejoicing in his days
whoever did not see Jerusalem in its splendour never saw a desirable city
whoever did not see the Temple in its building never saw a glorious building
[stam:] what is it? Abaye, and some say Rav Chisda: this is Herod's building
[stam:] with what did he build it? Rava: with stones of shaysha and marmara
some say: with stones of shaysha, kuchla and marmara
he set one row out and one row in
so that it would take the plaster
he [Herod] thought to overlay it with gold
the Rabbanan said to him: leave it, for it is finer so, as it looks like the waves of the sea
R' Yehuda: whoever did not see the diyoflaston of Alexandria of Egypt never saw the glory of Israel
they said: it was like a great basilica, a colonnade within a colonnade
at times there were in it (600,000 on 600,000), twice those who left Egypt
and there were in it seventy-one chairs of gold, each of no less than twenty-one myriad talents of gold
corresponding to the seventy-one of the Great Sanhedrin
and a wooden bima in its middle, the chazan of the synagogue standing on it with the scarves in his hand; when it came to answering amen, he waved the scarf and all the people answered amen
and they did not sit mixed: the goldsmiths by themselves, the silversmiths by themselves, the smiths by themselves, the coppersmiths by themselves, the weavers by themselves
and when a poor man entered there he would recognise the men of his craft and turn there, and from there was his livelihood and the livelihood of his household
Abaye: and all of them Alexander of Macedon killed
[stam:] why were they punished? because they transgressed this verse: 'you shall not return that way again'
'you shall not return that way again' (Deut 17:16)
and they came back
when he came, he found them reading in the book: 'the Lord will bring a nation against you from afar' (Deut 28:49)
he said: now, that man sought to bring the ship in ten days, and a wind lifted it and the ship came in five days
he fell upon them and killed them
